summary: Project foundation verified: validate and 20 unit tests pass. Concurrent claims, dependencies, scope/evidence categories, recorded evidence immutability and read-only inventory were tested without a phone.
limitations: Inventory tests use mocked ADB, not an actual S24.
No APK, XNU or hardware images were built.
At this stage, root, recovery and the owner device firmware were not confirmed.
The CLI records an experiment plan; its timeout field does not terminate a process.
Future private artifacts remain local; this baseline uses public host-check logs tracked in Git.

translation.note: English prose translation only. Original timestamps, outcomes, commands, measurements and historical artifact hashes are retained. This is not a new experiment or device observation.
